sentences.en: The child watched, round-eyed, as the horses galloped past.
sentences.vi: Đứa trẻ tròn mắt quan sát khi những con ngựa phi nước đại.

sentences.en: Civilians and soldiers mixed with round-eyed ladies from somewhere.

sentences.en: Believing it was Travis, she froze round-eyed as she found herself gazing into four faces as surprised as her own.

sentences.en: A round-eyed robot head sitting on the dashboard has cameras that can tell when a driver is getting sleepy.

sentences.en: But are round-eyed white-skinned blonds attractive to Chinese men beyond the quick fizz of a status conquest?

sentences.en: It was a child of about two, with fair skin, plump, round-eyed. 1 smiled and shrugged.

sentences.en: She rose to her feet and gazed upon him, round-eyed.

sentences.en: But then she might not be good at understanding the inflections of one such as this. Certainly it was hard to read the grimaces of such a round-eyed man.
sentences.vi: Nhưng sau đó cô ấy có thể không giỏi trong việc hiểu những nội dung như thế này. Chắc chắn khó có thể đọc được những nét mặt nhăn nhó của một người đàn ông mắt tròn như vậy.
